verdict.rationale: An API with UI parity is a fair question for an email-client SaaS, so the axis applies. The evidence only shows Shortwave's AI acting as a client that connects out to other apps via MCP, Zapier and built-in integrations, plus a Tasklet partner integration. There is no documented public API for driving Shortwave itself, and probes for an OpenAPI spec returned 404 on every path tried, so nothing evidences programmatic parity with the UI.
